_readme.what: Playtest feedback — the DRAGONSLEEP playtest lamp, one verdict per checklist line.
_readme.fold_back: Whoever takes this (Cowork seat or code tab): broken and unclear lines become the fix list; too hard / too easy are tuning; notes are the tester's words, verbatim. Load this file back into the lamp to keep going.

items.claim: Title → New Game → try each of the four leads once (intro text reads right for each?)
items.note: Vivian text to the Paladin still says "saw you come into town"

items.claim: Silverton: walk every street; doors open shops/keepers when you walk in; you're stepped back out after
items.note: need shop icons on the shop shops, make Mama's a shop, I never found 'the board at the weigh house' - mentioned in npc text at what i suspect is weigh house, sun symbol on the free sleep chapel

let's add easy 'help people in town' renown quest - courier missions between important NPCs, winters starts (he should also sell magic items (acquisitions))
